environment.description: Terraform provider running on the same EC2 instance type but with the following layered controls: (1) AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached to the ALB fronting the Terraform Cloud agent API endpoint, with AWS-AWSManagedRulesLinuxRuleSet in BLOCK mode which includes rule LFI_URIPATH that detects path traversal sequences in request bodies including the Terraform plan JSON payloads submitted via the API — this blocks any terraform apply containing destination_dir values with '../' or symlink-indicative path patterns before they reach the agent. (2) The EC2 instance runs with a custom seccomp profile (applied via containerd runtime class) that blocks the symlinkat(2), symlink(2), and linkat(2) syscalls for the provider process cgroup, preventing creation of new symlinks during plan/apply. (3) An AWS Systems Manager State Manager association enforces an AppArmor profile on the terraform-provider-* binaries that denies write access to any path outside /opt/terraform/workspaces/output/ after symlink resolution (using 'owner' conditional).

apparmor_profile.policy: deny write outside /opt/terraform/workspaces/output/ after symlink resolution
